note: Media priority for the YouTube film (docs/YOUTUBE_MEDIA_PRIORITY.md). The clean deliverables are the footage; the titled ORBITAL RECORD deliverables are creative reference only. Files are identified by sha256, never by name: both loops were supplied as loop-13s-1280.mp4.
policy: Evaluate shots, build the YouTube timeline and pick reusable footage from the primary-clean media only.
The creative-reference (titled) media show the approved ORBITAL RECORD motion language. They are never a timeline source.
No existing title has to stay baked into the YouTube edit.
A shot chosen from a titled deliverable is sourced from the matching clean frames (resolveCleanSource). Only graphics written for the new film are then applied.
New graphics are never stacked over existing ORBITAL RECORD graphics. Sourcing clean frames makes that impossible by construction.
Every clean-loop frame is also a clean-reel frame, at half the frame rate and 2/3 the size. Take the clean-reel frames.

media.note: The locked cut as released: run #6 footage, the c03/c04 holds and c14/c18 covers, and the corrected c12 still. Its end-card slot is the illustrated key-art card, which has the wordmark, tagline and URL baked in.
derivatives.loop: c07 c09 c10 c15 c16 c19 c20, keeping every second frame. This is the file audited in docs/LOOP_MOTION_TREATMENT.md. Every frame maps to one clean-reel frame (loopToReelFrames).
ORBITAL RECORD reel: E1-E9 records, P1-P6 plate pushes, and the typographic E8 end card on a black plate.
ORBITAL RECORD loop edition: L1-L3 records and the LP1 plate push.
